integrity: The exact enumeration, rank, and random limit are proved in RESULT.md. verify.py independently checks the finite closure and census in the documented range, but does not prove the asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: The birthday limit fixes the chain cardinality and assumes independent uniform entries. Generalized implication is the coordinatewise Heyting operation, and there are no global quantifiers or intermediate named constants. The originality comparison cannot exclude an implicit antecedent in older universal-algebra literature.
title: Exact generating-tuple census and birthday law for finite Heyting-chain powers
